operation: On the v2 backing, clone built-in Show 302 and select Clip hero-windows (Mandelbrot2D on the shared pendulum instance). In the Clip detail's Playback tab, under 'Global placement and clock controls', the 'Restart Pattern on entry' checkbox is aria-disabled but not natively disabled; focusing it by keyboard shows the reason tip 'This Pattern's state can't be reset.' (capture 1). A click and a Space press on it leave it unticked and write nothing. Then clone built-in Show 301 and select Clip clip-floor-rose (CompassRose): the same checkbox is enabled with no reason (capture 2). Capture 3 reads back both stored v2 rows through GET /api/shows?show-version=2: hero-windows keeps entryPolicy continue after the click and Space press; clip-floor-rose is continue and editable. Capture 4 is the raw GET /api/shows?show-version=2 response listing both clones as version 2 rows.
